name: Warsaw Chopin Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest is 15/33, 3,690 m long and 60 m wide (11/29 is 2,800 m × 50 m)

handling.v: handling agents named in the AIP: LS Airport Services, Welcome Airport Services and Excel Handling; GA flights without an agent are handled by the pilot-in-command
handling.quote: the pilot-in-command (for general aviation flights without a handling agent)

slots.v: slot-coordinated airport (IATA Level 3); the A-CDM process cannot start without an airport slot

curfew.v: night period 22:00–06:00 local: all operators are subject to noise limits, and slots may be denied if the overall nightly limit is breached
curfew.quote: during the night period (2200-0600 Local Time) will be subject to noise limits,

noise.v: all civil operators must submit a valid noise certificate
noise.quote: All operators of civil aircraft operating to and from Warsaw F. Chopin airport are required to submit a valid noise

max_aircraft.v: aircraft larger than ICAO Code E need separate authorisation from the aerodrome duty officers
max_aircraft.quote: To obtain authorization for flights operated by aircraft larger than Code E,

notes: AIP: PANSA eAIP IFR AIRAC AMDT 10-26 (1 Oct 2026), page 'AD 2 EPWA 1' only (it ends inside AD 2.20; the next pages could not be opened). Night rule and slot level come from the coordinator's (ACL) WAW page, which shows S26/S27 content but no page date and does not itself say ACL is the appointed coordinator. The night rule is a noise quota with possible slot refusal, not a full closure. The AIP location line gives distance and bearing without naming the reference point.
